query:
SELECT id, cardId, snkrdunkId, name, nameJa, series, cardNumber, rarity, imageUrl 
FROM cards 
WHERE name LIKE '%Lillie%' OR nameJa LIKE '%リーリエ%'
LIMIT 10;
